channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Sean Elliott | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Sean Elliott from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Sean Elliott, Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Fred Katz:Scott Brooks on the turnover with 37 seconds remaining wher ethey called Westbrook out of bounds:

“The camera angle I saw, it was like the Sean Elliott play…Theyobviously looked at a bunch of different angles and they called what they called.”

Scott Brooks on Sean Elliott, Russell Westbrook, May 23, 2021. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Tony Parker on David Robinson, Sean Elliott, George Gervin
item.description:
Asked if more teams should try to rebuild around an aging core, as the Spurs did compared to the Celtics, Parker said Sunday:

“I can’t talk for other teams, but the Spurs have always been very loyal to their guys. You see George Gervin, David Robinson, Sean Elliott.”

Tony Parker on David Robinson, Sean Elliott, George Gervin, Dec 1, 2014. Source: San Antonio Express-News.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Sean Elliott
item.description:
“Zarko could have had a 47-inch vertical jump and been the best shooter in the world, and it wasn’t going to happen because Sean Elliott was the American who had been drafted,”

Gregg Popovich on Sean Elliott, Oct 15, 2013. Source: New York Times.
